env.ours: x3d.threejs reader (shared with the Babylon bridge) + three.js body, bundle sha f3c23e9dcc27

gaps: a sensor inside a Transform reports geoCoord_changed of the local position (X_ITE's shortcut), not the viewer's geographic position
X_ITE sends isActive false and exitTime twice when the sensor is disabled while active: the bridge sends them once (the fixture asserts at least one)
the viewer's own navigation (mouse, keys) is not simulated: the camera is moved by writing the Viewpoint position
events carry the pose of the camera in the same frame (no frame of lag as in X_ITE)
